notes:
One file browser for Drive and computers, Photos folders, and releases built off the Hub.

- One file browser for Drive and computers, with Trash, Undo, path entry and the same rows everywhere.
- Photos: hidden folders, a Folders page and no image size limit; free up rechecks only what you confirmed.
- Drive has no size limits, mounts in the standard place for each system, and mounted folders handle large files, long paths, timestamps and read-only mounts.
- Scenes are gone; every scene is now an automation you run by hand.
- The assistant's MCP link uses a fixed port and survives restarts.
- Releases are built on a computer or by GitHub and uploaded signed; the Hub no longer builds them and never rolls back without asking.
- Fewer Hub log floods and faster pages.
